rules: FFMA register form: -B / -C, .SAT, exact cancellation, overflow -> +inf, inf operand (inputs where fused and FMul+FAdd agree; Vulkan allows either)
reference: Inputs w0=0x3f800000(1.0), w1=0xc0200000(-2.5), w2=0x40490fdb(3.1415927410125732), w3=0x3a83126f(0.0010000000474974513), w4=0x477fe000(65504.0), w5=0xbf400000(-0.75), w6=0x3fc00000(1.5), w7=0x3dcccccd(0.10000000149011612); every other word i is the guard ((i+1)*0x9e3779b9+0x31415926) mod 2^32; special bit patterns set by MOV32I. IEEE binary32, round to nearest even, bit-exact: FFMA = a*b+c formed exactly (rational) and rounded once (fused); - negates B (product) or C; FFMA32I C = Rd; .SAT clamps to [0,1]; beyond range -> inf; FMNMX = IEEE minNum / maxNum after |x| then -; c[0][*] = +0.0. w8 = FFMA(w0, w1, w2) = 0x3f243f6c(0.6415927410125732); w9 = FFMA(w2, w7, w0) = 0x3fa8365f(1.3141592741012573); w10 = FFMA(w0, -w1, w2) = 0x40b487ee(5.641592979431152); w11 = FFMA(w0, w1, -w2) = 0xc0b487ee(-5.641592979431152); w12 = FFMA(w5, w6, w4) = 0x477fdee0(65502.875); w13 = FFMA(0x3f800800, w0, 0xbf801000) = 0xb9800000(-0.000244140625); w14 = FFMA(0x7f7fffff, w0, w0) = 0x7f7fffff(3.4028234663852886e+38); w15 = FFMA.SAT(w0, w6, w0) = 0x3f800000(1.0); w16 = FFMA.SAT(w5, w6, w7) = 0x00000000(0.0); w17 = FFMA.SAT(w7, w7, w7) = 0x3de147ae(0.10999999940395355); w18 = FFMA(0x7f7fffff, 0x7f7fffff, w0) = 0x7f800000(inf); w19 = FFMA(0x7f800000, w0, w0) = 0x7f800000(inf); words 20-63 unchanged.
